description: This file is a CodeMirror addon that implements a selection pointer feature, allowing cursor style changes based on mouse position over selected text.

methods.name: mousemove
methods.description: Handles mouse move events to update cursor position and schedule UI update.

methods.name: mouseout
methods.description: Handles mouse out events to reset cursor position and schedule UI update.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the selection pointer rectangle data and schedules an update.

methods.name: scheduleUpdate
methods.description: Schedules an update to the cursor style with a debounce of 50ms.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the cursor style based on mouse position relative to selected text rectangles.
